name: OPD Register
description: OPD Register - Outpatient Department register with comprehensive patient encounter data

baseCohortDefinition.name: Patients with OPD encounters between dates

config.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id
FROM encounter e
INNER JOIN encounter_type et ON et.encounter_type_id = e.encounter_type
WHERE et.uuid = 'ee4780f5-b5eb-423b-932f-00b5879df5ab'
AND e.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
AND e.voided = 0
